title: Agreement determines a read block
statement: Let $\tau,\tau':\mathbb N\to\{0,1\}$ and let $i,w\in\mathbb N$. If $\tau(i+j)=\tau'(i+j)$ for every integer $j$ with $0\le j<w$, then the length-$w$ blocks read from position $i$ in these two sequences are equal.
hypotheses_covered: The two sequences agree at every position $i+j$ for $0\le j<w$.
